reports.title: Wolfspeed Reports Financial Results for the First Quarter of Fiscal 2027

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: The Company targets to generate revenue between $155 million and $175 million for its second quarter of fiscal 2027 with sequential non-GAAP gross margin improvement approaching breakeven. The Company targets non-GAAP operating expenses between $65 million and $69 million for its second quarter of fiscal 2027. Please see "Non-GAAP Guidance" below for additional information.
